description: METAR / SPECI decoder with flight category — Decodes up to 20 METAR or SPECI aviation weather reports (US and ICAO forms: wind with gusts and variable direction, visibility in statute miles or metres, CAVOK, RVR, present weather, cloud layers, temperature/dew point, altimeter, trend, RMK remarks) into structured fields and computes the FAA flight category (LIFR/IFR/MVFR/VFR). Every token it cannot decode is returned with its character offset

claims.description: Optional claims to verify against the decoded report.

windSpeed.description: Claimed mean wind speed in the report's own unit.

items.description: One METAR or SPECI report, optionally ending in '='.

name: metar-parse
